text:
Jess: quick async standup — onboarding llama3-tinyq-v2 into evals / heads-up on a weird address-normalization regression
- did: ran full promptset + structured-output checks for address normalization (en/es), added a small deterministic test harness
- blocker: Spanish postal address cases with hashes/nums (e.g., 'Calle 5 #10') are getting stripped or merged — downstream postprocess expects separate number tokens and our new tokenizer/quantized run outputs sometimes collapse '#10' -> '# 10' or '10' only
- today: triage cause (tokenizer vs quant path), add focused prompt tests, open PR for a lightweight postprocess fallback, and ask infra to run a tiny quant A/B run

Sam: can you paste a minimal example output vs expected?

Jess: example:
- input: "Calle 5 #10, Madrid"
- expected: "Calle 5 #10, Madrid" (structured: {street: \"Calle 5\", number: \"#10\"})
- actual: "Calle 5 10, Madrid" -> losing '#', parse fails in postprocess

Noah: hunch: change in token boundaries after the quant kernel tweak. Try running the model with the tokenizer in isolation (cpu) vs the quant run and diff token ids. Quick snip: 
```python
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('llama3-tinyq-v2')
print(tok.tokenize('Calle 5 #10, Madrid'))
```
If token ids differ materially then kernel/merge logic is the suspect.

Jess: good call — I ran that and saw different merges under the quant runtime. Opening an issue with a tiny repro + token id diffs.

Anya: I can review the PR once it's up. @Jess please add a short test in evals that asserts the structured parse for at least 10 Spanish address variants.

Jess: will do. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/4321 (adds postprocess fallback + tests)

deploy-bot: Canary deploy for llama3-tinyq-v2 completed in us-west-2 — 3% traffic routed :rocket:

Sam: I'll re-run the nightly evals once the PR lands. Noting eval run 9876 had the highest regression score for addresses: https://console.redwood.ai/evals/9876

Noah: if fallback postprocess fixes it, we should still track root cause for long term; filing a follow-up ticket to align kernels + tokenizer merges.

Jess: thanks team :thumbsup: — blocker status: in-progress (PR open, infra pinged for extra quant runs). Will update when PR merges + nightly completes.
